summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend testing of 5P. Rewrote backend test suite for new schema (recommendation key + OTP + status gating). 22/22 pytest cases pass. Frontend smoke verified register→verify-OTP→pending flow, status-gated /feed redirect, /admin pending+keys tabs with mint-key working, and /champions Hall of Fame page rendering with champion post (admin-boosted to 15 likes).

minor.issue: Still no brute-force lockout (5-fail) per playbook. Acceptable for MVP.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec (browsers may reject in strict mode). Pin to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin.

Sets cookies (logs the user in) immediately, even though status=pending_email. This is required for /verify-otp to authenticate the user, but means a registered user is implicitly authenticated before email verification. Acceptable since require_active blocks all non-active actions.
Allows rejecting a user still in pending_email (before they verified email). UX OK but worth confirming intent.
Filter does post-fetch in-memory filter (find $or, then python comprehension on threshold). Fine at low volume; index/filter at DB layer if it scales.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~970 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, posts.py, comments.py, messages.py, admin.py, status.py) before iteration 4.

OTP and password-reset secrets are logged at INFO level ('OTP for ... (dev): NNNNNN', 'Password reset ... token): xxx'). Convenient for dev/testing but a real PII/security leak in production. Gate behind an APP_ENV='dev' check before shipping.

consume_recommendation_code() raises 400 only on the find_one path; the conditional update_one ({code, used: False}) prevents double-consume but does not error if the race loses — earlier guard masks it, but worth a return-value check on update_one.modified_count to be defensive.

maybe_promote_to_champion is invoked on every like and every boost — fine for now; consider preventing reverse demotion if boost is reduced below 15 (currently is_champion stays true once set, which matches the 'archived permanently' spec).
Admin-line DM cleanup deletes messages older than 24h on every list_conversations call. For high-traffic scenarios prefer a TTL index on messages.created_at where admin_line=true.

send_otp / send_password_reset / send_admin_decision are awaited synchronously inside request handlers. If Resend hangs (which has happened in testing), the request hangs too. Wrap in asyncio.create_task with logging.
compute_status() runs daily_state get/create + 2 mongo counts on every request; cache per-user per-second.
No rate limit on /api/auth/forgot-password; could be used for token spam to a known email. Add IP-based throttle.
/api/admin/keys mint endpoint has no body — fine, but consider supporting batch mint to reduce admin clicks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke flows (register, OTP verify, pending redirect, admin tabs, mint key, champions page)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@iastate.edu / admin123 (auto-seeded). Test users created dynamically as test_<hex>@iastate.edu / testpass123 via admin-minted recommendation keys. OTPs and reset tokens read from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log via tail+regex.
seed_data_creation: Tests mint many admin keys + create transient users (status pending_email/pending_review/active/rejected). Test users persist (no cleanup endpoint), but each cycle is isolated by random emails. Champion test creates+boosts then deletes a post.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover all iter-3 flows. Helpers: _mint_admin_key(), _register_and_verify() (registers + reads OTP from logs + verifies), _make_active_user() (verify + admin approve). _backdate_unlock_all() forces past unlock. OTP and reset-token retrieval rely on the dev-mode logger.info lines in server.py — if those are gated behind APP_ENV in future, tests must change. Frontend data-testids confirmed present: register-key-input/email-input/password-input/submit-btn, otp-input, otp-submit, tab-pending, tab-keys, mint-key-btn, champion-hero. Did not exhaustively click Approve/Reject in admin UI or test the comment-as-admin checkbox UI; covered at API level instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — all tested behaviors match spec.
